relations.text: SmartFinancialが10-Kで、回転信用枠(リボルビング・ノート)の貸し手として挙げる

source.quote: The Amended and Restated Revolving Note, dated as of May 1, 2025, by and between SmartFinancial, Inc., as Borrower, and ServisFirst Bank, as Lender.

relations.text: CoastalSouthが10-Kで、1,800万ドルの回転信用枠の貸し手として挙げる
